answer: Every claim faces a live pulse check. Within a day of filing, the Copper desk sends the filer one question about the delta — the key change they made while doing the work — and the filer must answer it live within ten minutes, naming the choice they made and why. A claim whose filer cannot answer, or answers like a script, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 people who can answer live about work they never did, plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims, and every answer about the delta came back identical — the desk voided all forty.
